fields.quoted_span:
It is unlawful for any real estate lessor, agent, or subcontractor thereof, to subscribe to, contract with, or otherwise
exchange anything of value in return for the services of a Service Provider.
fields.note: Core prohibition, definitions, enforcement and penalties are supported by DX02. However, the 'or otherwise utilize' amendment from Ord. 25-076 is not in DX02, which contains only the original text. The 'any person performing a coordinating function' definition and the 'two or more lessors or public databases' collection element are supported. The 'and exempts same-owner' point is in the exemptions field, not here.

fields.quoted_span:
A first violation of § 218-12 shall be punishable as provided in Chapter 1, General Provisions, Art. I, § 1-25.
Subsequent violations shall be punished by a fine of not less than $100 and up to $2000
fields.note: First violation under § 1-25, subsequent $100–$2,000, each day a separate violation, and private right of action with costs and attorney fees are all in DX02 (§3(b), 3(c), 3(d)).
The field is empty, and DX02 states no effective date. It gives only adoption (May 21, 2025) and mayoral approval (May 22, 2025) dates.

fields.quoted_span: Adopted on second and final reading after hearing on May 21 2025
fields.note: DX02 shows the ordinance was adopted and approved by the Mayor, but it does not state that it is currently in force. The Ord. 25-076 amendment is not in this document.

fields.quoted_span:
“Residential dwelling unit” means any house, apartment, accessory unit, or other unit intended to be used as a
person’s primary residence; and does not include inpatient medical care, licensed long-term care, and detention or
correctional facilities.
fields.note: The lessor definition (owner of real property leasing it as a residential dwelling unit) and the residential unit definition with exclusions match DX02. No size or age conditions are stated, consistent with the null fields.

fields.quoted_span: §218-12 Preventing Algorithmic Rent Fixing in the Rental Housing Market:
fields.note: DX02 supports § 218-12, Chapter 218 and Ord. 25-057 as well as the title. 'Jersey City Code' as the code name is supported only loosely. Ord. 25-076 and the 'Jersey City RealPage ban' alias do not appear in DX02.
